title: Writing a managed table
prompt: Which PySpark call writes a DataFrame as a managed Delta table in the attached lakehouse?

options.why: Correct. saveAsTable registers the Delta table in the lakehouse with the chosen write mode.

options.why: show prints rows; nothing is written.

options.why: CSV writes unmanaged files, not a Delta table.

explanation: Delta writes go through write.format("delta") with saveAsTable (managed) or save(path) (by path) — the documented PySpark pattern.

options.text: mode("ignore")
options.why: Ignore skips the write if the target exists — nothing lands.

explanation: Save modes are standard Delta semantics: append accumulates, overwrite replaces, error/ignore guard.
